note: EXPLORATORY: defined after the primary results were seen, not pre-registered. Descriptive only; not a test of the pre-registered comparisons.
seed_note: All resampling uses this seed. Paired differences use moral_judgment.metrics.summarize unchanged, with its module seed temporarily set to this value (main analysis used 20260913); each summarize call restarts from it. The overlapping panel draws and the Spearman bootstraps share one Random(seed) stream, in that order; the disjoint panel draws use a separate Random(seed).
labels_used: valid labels and statuses as recorded; no reparse

dispersion.note: EXPLORATORY: defined after the primary results were seen, not pre-registered. Descriptive only; not a test of the pre-registered comparisons.
dispersion.units: entropy in bits (max 2 over four labels)

panel_ceiling.note: EXPLORATORY: defined after the primary results were seen, not pre-registered. Descriptive only; not a test of the pre-registered comparisons.
panel_ceiling.definition: per item, mean over 1000 draws of base-2 JSD between 10 non-INFO votes drawn without replacement and the remaining non-INFO votes of that item (disjoint); items with at least 20 non-INFO votes

overlapping_biased_low.definition: first-pass version: panel scored against the full distribution, which includes the panel itself, so the divergence is biased low; superseded, kept for the record

contested_vs_consensus.note: EXPLORATORY: defined after the primary results were seen, not pre-registered. Descriptive only; not a test of the pre-registered comparisons.
contested_vs_consensus.split_rule: low: human entropy <= median; high: human entropy > median

verdict_shift.note: EXPLORATORY: defined after the primary results were seen, not pre-registered. Descriptive only; not a test of the pre-registered comparisons.
verdict_shift.definition: per label, mean over items of each per-item distribution (model: valid labels; human: non-INFO renormalised); paired differences are per label, over items where both sides are defined

modal_agreement.note: EXPLORATORY: defined after the primary results were seen, not pre-registered. Descriptive only; not a test of the pre-registered comparisons.
modal_agreement.definition: per item, 1 if the model modal set and the human modal set share a label, else 0. Human ties count as a match if the model mode is any tied label, as specified; model ties are handled the same way (match if any tied model label is a human modal label), which was not specified and is reported separately
